text_simplified: Gentleness is a foundational principle in tarbiyah. Showing rifq toward your children, treating them with mercy, and avoiding harshness or coldness are essential. Gentleness is not found in anything except that it adorns it. This mercy should begin from a young age and continue, for it is a cause of children drawing close to their parents and loving them, and through it guidance and acceptance of advice become easy. Among such examples is the Prophet ﷺ kissing al-Hasan ibn Ali, and his saying to one who did not kiss his children: 'Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.'
